actual: paper_v2 daemon telemetry events are written into qe_archive.outbox_event with routing_class=telemetry, but the production QE archive worker only claims archive QE event types. After BUG-471 isolates archive routing, these telemetry rows remain a silent durable blackhole with 21k pending rows; low-frequency paper archive events are also not registered in the live worker. Need plan-first fix covering scoped cleanup SQL, telemetry routing/reaper decision, explicit skip/audit for unprocessable paper events, and no DB writes until user approval.
